item.title: [Podcast] A ‘Just Transition’ for Two Market Stalls in Nigeria
item.description:
Every crisis presents an opportunity. For the European Union and India, Russia’s war on Ukraine and the high oil and gas prices that followed was a chance to deepen their energy independence. They used direct and indirect subsidies, as well as cheap loans to move citizens one inch away from volatile fuels into energy sources that cannot be cut off or restricted by conflict.
For governments like Nigeria, the narrative is not budging from a cost-of-living burden that is eroding disposable income. Yet, people are making the transition from fossil fuels not because they are offered collateral-free solar loans, but because they are looking for constant power from any source.
